_comment: Machine-readable identity registry for Polaris Stage-2 components.
Why this exists: docs/release-change-summary-v117-astro.json records purpose, changes and
known_limits but NO component hashes. Nothing in the repo therefore stated what bytes
6.0.0.54.117 was supposed to run. On 2026-11-26 a hot-swap replaced the deployed loader with
locally built bytes while the device still reported FwVer .117, and no check could detect it.
This file makes 'what is running' comparable to 'what should be running', fail-closed.
* An artifact is REGISTERED only if its md5 appears here.
* Anything else is UNREGISTERED and scripts/device-identity.py exits non-zero.
* Add an entry only with the git commit that produces it, verified by rebuild.
* Never edit an entry in place; a rebuilt artifact is a new entry.

artifacts.label: shipped-astro-v117
artifacts.note: Bytes as installed by the 6.0.0.54.117 package. Preserved on device at libpolaris_stage2.so.pre-hotswap. Byte-identical to a container rebuild of container/stage2_loader.c at commit 43147f1^ (the pre-gate-fix source), which proves the build recipe and slot table reproduce the shipped binary exactly.

artifacts.label: gate-fix-qualified
artifacts.note: Camera-gate fix plus the held_ms diagnostic correction. Reproduced byte-for-byte from a129f89 with the canonical filename stage2_ondisk_loader.c (the source name is embedded in the binary, so any other filename yields a different hash). Qualified on a live K-1 II: 150/150 parameter reads at app load, plain capture PASS.

artifacts.label: set-trace-diagnostic
artifacts.note: Adds STAGE2_SET_TRACE=1 logging of setCameraConfig key/value/ret at the pgphoto-to-core boundary. Off unless the env var is set. Diagnostic only; must never reach a release package.

artifacts.label: shipped-astro-v117
artifacts.note: Benro's proprietary Stage-2 head. Not built by this repo; read-only for analysis. Carries the issue #230 bulb poll budget (movw r3,#10000 at capture_image_with_Bulb+0x594) and defines -2110 internally in getLocalCameraParamInfo.

_launcher_note: Env vars the SHIPPED /app/bin/pgphoto declares. A diagnostic flag left in the launcher
changes what an otherwise-registered binary does, so it is part of identity. STAGE2_SET_TRACE
was added by hand on 2026-11-26 and is deliberately absent from this list: its presence must
fail the check rather than be normalised.

6.0.0.54.117.gap: The release record contains no component hashes. This expected{} block was reconstructed on 2026-11-26 from the on-device pre-hotswap backup, not from the package, so it documents what was observed rather than what was published.
